label: Hand-written English placeholder
source: Hand-written for the dual-language feature — no generator, no upstream.
notes: Scaffolding that made dual-language gameplay testable, ~13 days of content at 3 words/day. Superseded by en/v2; kept so a rollback is possible and so the batches drawn from it while it was active still resolve. Word ids are "en-1".."en-40" — deliberately NOT the same id namespace as en/v2's "en1".."en1100".
